**8B.5 Research Note: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva in 2024**

Overall, the 2024 record is **moderately positive** on internal discipline and follow-through. The strongest evidence is formal institutional coordination: budgeting, interministerial monitoring, targeted enforcement, and rule-based implementation. The main negatives are **macro-management slippage**, **Petrobras/patronage caveats**, and **continued implementation gaps** in vulnerable regions.

| Direction | Title | Publisher | Date | URL | Claim-level summary | QIDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|---|
| Positive | **PPA 2024-2027 formal governance and management procedures** | Presidência da República / Planalto | 2024-06-18 | https://www.planalto.gov.br/ccivil_03/_ato2023-2026/2024/decreto/d12066.htm | Lula’s government created formal monitoring, evaluation, review, and budget-alignment procedures for the PPA, which is strong evidence of cross-ministry coordination and follow-through. | 8B.5 |
| Positive | **Plano Plurianual 2024-2027** | Ministry of Planning and Budget | 2024-12-19 | https://www.gov.br/planejamento/pt-br/assuntos/planejamento/plano-plurianual/paginas/paginas-ppa-2024-2027/ppa-2024-2027-english | The PPA translated the government’s agenda into six priorities, 88 programs, and annual-budget linkage, showing durable program architecture rather than ad hoc direction. | 8B.5 |
| Positive | **Novo PAC selection round invests R$23 billion in health, education, sports, and culture** | Casa Civil | 2024-03-07 | https://www.gov.br/casacivil/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/2024/marco/novo-pac-selecoes-vai-investir-r-23-bilhoes-em-saude-educacao-esporte-e-cultura | Large formal spending was routed through sectoral ministries and low-coverage areas, indicating administrative mobilization across government rather than fragmented patronage. | 8B.5 |
| Positive | **Governo Federal completa mil operações na Terra Indígena Yanomami** | Ministério dos Povos Indígenas | 2024-07-16 | https://www.gov.br/povosindigenas/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/2024/07/governo-federal-completa-mil-operacoes-realizadas-na-terra-indigena-yanomami-no-periodo-de-cinco-meses | The government reported 1,000 coordinated operations in five months against illegal mining in Yanomami territory, which is strong evidence of sustained enforcement follow-through. | 8B.5 |
| Positive | **Decreto formaliza condicionalidades e monitoramento do Bolsa Família** | Presidência da República | 2024-06-17 | https://www.presidencia.gov.br/Ccivil_03/_Ato2023-2026/2024/Decreto/D12064.htm | Bolsa Família was tied to health, education, and interministerial monitoring, showing disciplined coordination across ministries and a rules-based implementation chain. | 8B.5 |
| Positive | **CGU avalia condições de permanência do Bolsa Família** | Controladoria-Geral da União | 2024-12-09 | https://www.gov.br/cgu/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/2024/12/cgu-presente-controladoria-geral-da-uniao-avalia-condicoes-de-permanencia-do-programa-bolsa-familia | CGU’s review of conditionality monitoring shows the administration was using oversight and corrective feedback, not just distributing benefits. | 8B.5 |
| Positive | **Lula signs decree updating civil-society partnership rules** | Secretaria-Geral da Presidência | 2024-03-13 | https://www.gov.br/secretariageral/pt-br/noticias/2024/marco/presidente-lula-assina-decreto-que-atualiza-regras-para-a-implementacao-de-politicas-publicas-em-parcerias-com-as-organizacoes-da-sociedade-civil | The government formalized civil-society partnerships to improve execution and participation, which supports cross-institution coordination and delivery capacity. | 8B.5 |
| Positive | **Decree updates police use-of-force rules** | Presidência da República / Planalto | 2024-12-23 | https://www.planalto.gov.br/ccivil_03/_ato2023-2026/2024/decreto/d12341.htm | Lula tightened police-force rules around legality, necessity, due process, and non-discrimination, which is evidence of control over security institutions and standardization of conduct. | 8B.5 |
| Positive | **Decree requires integrity programs for large federal contracts** | CGU / Presidência da República | 2024-12-09 | https://www.gov.br/cgu/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/2024/12/dia-internacional-de-combate-a-corrupcao-presidente-lula-assina-decreto-que-fortalece-integridade-em-contratos-publicos | The administration imposed integrity-program requirements and CGU monitoring on major contractors, which is strong evidence for institutional control over procurement. | 8B.5 |
| Negative | **Reuters reports Lula pressed central bank to ignore market preferences** | Reuters via UOL | 2024-07-01 | https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/07/01/lula-critica-bc-autonomo-e-diz-que-autoridade-monetaria-nao-atende-populacao.htm | Lula publicly pressured the central bank, which weakened technocratic discipline and showed a real limit in coordination with an insulated institution. | 8B.5 |
| Negative | **Reuters reports government interference concerns in Petrobras dividend decision** | Reuters via UOL | 2024-03-18 | https://economia.uol.com.br/noticias/reuters/2024/03/18/ministerio-publico-do-tcu-pede-investigacao-de-possivel-interferencia-do-governo-na-petrobras.htm | The TCU prosecutor asked whether the government had improperly steered Petrobras, which is the strongest sign of discretionary interference in a strategic firm. | 8B.5 |
| Negative | **Lula did not immediately remove indicted minister Juscelino Filho** | Reuters via UOL | 2024-06-12 | https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/06/12/ministro-das-comunicacoes-e-indiciado-pela-pf-por-corrupcao-em-investigacao-sobre-desvio-na-codevasf-dizem-fontes.htm | A cabinet minister remained in place after indictment, which is the clearest patronage/coalition-protection caveat against clean internal discipline. | 8B.5 |
| Negative | **Government still needed spending freezes and showed creative accounting** | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-09-18 | https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/analysisbrazils-tinkering-to-meet-fiscal-target-threatens-to-dent-credibility-3620814 | Reuters said the government relied on creative accounting and later spending freezes, which is evidence of weaker macro-level discipline and uneven execution. | 8B.5 |
| Negative | **Yanomami crisis remained severe despite emergency action** | Reuters via UOL | 2024-01-26 | https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/01/26/crise-do-povo-yanomami-persiste-apos-308-mortes-em-2023-diz-relatorio.htm | Yanomami leaders still reported invasion, malnutrition, disease, and violence, showing that follow-through in a hard-to-reach territory was incomplete. | 8B.5 |

**Best read**
- Strongest positives: **PPA institutionalization, interministerial welfare monitoring, Yanomami enforcement, procurement integrity, and bounded security control**.
- Strongest negatives: **central bank pressure, Petrobras steering, delayed minister removal, and fiscal credibility problems**.
- Search gap: I found **little direct evidence on PT party-structure discipline itself**. Most of the usable evidence is about cabinet coordination, agencies, territorial enforcement, and budget execution rather than internal party machinery.
